correctness.rationale: PASS: Define 49 queen squares (r,c)∈(Z/7)^2, attacks on equal rows, columns or either wrapped diagonal. Independent exhaustive increasing-row/column placements reproduce exactly augmented face vector (1,49,588,2156,2450,882,196,28), 6350 total including empty. Independently rebuilt boundary matrices have ranks over F2 and F5 (1,48,540,1616,714,168,28), over F3 (1,48,540,1615,714,168,28), detecting 3-primary torsion; a field-rank drop alone cannot distinguish Z/9 from Z/3 or (Z/3)^2. Inspected actual package verify.py, which specifies integral elementary unit-cancellation counts (28,168,714,1615,540,48,1) descending, a 541×121 residual 4-to-3 boundary whose 84 nonzero columns are rationally rank one, integer primitive scalar gcd one and entry gcd nine, then exact survivor/chain-identity check. Its unimodular rank-one Smith invariant is nine and final chain groups C3=Z^121, C2=Z, giving H̃2=Z/9 and H̃3=Z^120. Crucially an independent earlier full 2026-10-25 published construction of the same complex and integral Morse Smith certificate also yields invariant nine, independently corroborating the principal finite claim. We did not rerun the current full integral reduction; field checks are explicitly subordinate to the exact integral argument.
